import re

PER_TEST = re.compile(r"^(?P<value>\d+ seconds?) per test\s*$")
ODIRECT = re.compile(r"^O_DIRECT (?P<value>.*?)\.?\s*$")
TITLE = re.compile(r"^(?P<title>\S.*?):\s*$")
NOTE = re.compile(r"^\((?P<text>.*?)\)?\s*$")
ROW = re.compile(r"^\s+(?P<test>\S(?:.*?\S)?)\s{2,}(?P<ops>[\d.]+|n/a)(?: ops/sec\s+(?P<usecs>\d+) usecs/op)?\s*$")


def parse(lines):
    config, config_lines, rows, row_lines = {}, [], [], []
    section, note, in_note = "", [], False
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        m = PER_TEST.match(ln)
        if m:
            config["time per test"] = m.group("value"); config_lines.append(i); continue
        m = ODIRECT.match(ln)
        if m:
            config["O_DIRECT"] = m.group("value"); config_lines.append(i); continue
        m = ROW.match(ln)
        if m:
            in_note = False
            rows.append({"section": section, "note": " ".join(note), "test": m.group("test"),
                         "ops/sec": m.group("ops"), "usecs/op": m.group("usecs") or ""})
            row_lines.append(i); continue
        m = TITLE.match(ln)
        if m and not ln.startswith("("):
            section, note, in_note = m.group("title"), [], False; row_lines.append(i); continue
        if ln.startswith("(") or in_note:
            text = ln.strip()
            in_note = not text.endswith(")")
            note.append(text.strip("()")); row_lines.append(i); continue
    blocks = [{"name": "config", "kind": "kv", "lines": config_lines, "records": [config]},
              {"name": "sync methods", "kind": "table", "lines": row_lines, "records": rows}]
    return blocks
